args.query: RFC 9110 section 15.5.11 HTTP 410 Gone likely permanent

content.text:
**HTTP 410 Gone** means the requested resource is no longer available at the origin server and the condition is **likely permanent**. If the server cannot determine permanence, it should use **404 Not Found** instead. A 410 is intended to signal that links should be removed, and it is heuristically cacheable unless overridden by method semantics or explicit cache controls. ([rfc-editor.org](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html?utm_source=openai))
